note: Eleven single-module sweeps produce this report, one for each module. The `commit` field names the commit every sweep read under `ja4plus/`. Two commits ran the sweeps, and `git diff b9738d6 1578ab7 -- ja4plus/` is empty, so the swept code is one state. `sweeps` holds the result of each module: the test files of its cover, the cases it collected, and the candidates it named. `candidates` is the union over the eleven, because a case one module kills is still unmeasured against another.
